The Land in Full Colour

Price: AUD 200.00

In stock

The Land in Full Colour celebrates the energy and beauty found within the Australian landscape. Layers of orange, green, blue, pink and deep earthy tones flow across the canvas, forming hills, pathways and fragments of water. Through expressive brushstrokes and vibrant colour, Alpana Rai presents nature not exactly as it appears, but as it is remembered and felt—alive with movement, warmth and optimism. Somewhere Between Here and Home

Medium: acrylic on canvas

Price: AUD 1650.00

In stock

Somewhere Between Here and Home is a vibrant abstract landscape exploring the emotional space between the places we leave behind and the life we create ahead. Winding paths, flowing waterways, distant hills and small human-made structures emerge through expressive layers of colour and mark-making. The painting does not describe one particular location. Instead, it brings together fragments of remembered and imagined landscapes—as though different places are living within us at the same time. Warm oranges and yellows carry optimism and energy, while soft blues create moments of reflection and calm. Created in acrylic on canvas and presented in a natural oak frame, this original artwork brings colour, movement and a deeply personal sense of place into a contemporary interior. What the Earth Remembers

Medium: Acrylic on wood

Dimensions: 20 x 25 cm

Price: AUD 200.00

Rich layers of ochre, burnt orange, deep brown, cream and soft pink come together in this expressive abstract landscape. Small flashes of blue and green bring movement and life, while the sweeping pale forms suggest hills, rocky passages and pathways shaped by time. What the Earth Remembers reflects the idea that landscapes hold traces of everything that has passed through them—seasons, journeys, memories and human connection. Its earthy palette and textured brushwork create a warm, grounded painting with moments of unexpected colour and optimism. Purest Joy

Medium: acrylic on canvas

Price: AUD 750.00

In stock

Purest Joy is a vibrant abstract landscape celebrating those rare moments when happiness feels effortless and complete. Layers of joyful pink, luminous yellow, vivid blue and earthy burgundy unfold across the canvas like hills, winding paths and fragments of remembered places. Expressive brushwork and playful marks bring energy and movement to the composition, while glimpses of trees and distant forms invite the viewer to wander through a landscape shaped by emotion and imagination. Both uplifting and deeply personal, this artwork is a reminder that the purest joy is often found in colour, freedom and the simple beauty of being present. Painted in acrylic on canvas and presented in a natural oak frame, Purest Joy will bring warmth, optimism and a striking sense of life to a contemporary interior. Where the Wild Hills Bloom 2

Medium: Acrylic on Canvas

Dimensions: 20.5 × 20.5 cm

Price: AUD 200.00

In stock

Where the Wild Hills Bloom explores the landscape as a place shaped by colour, memory and emotion. Layers of pink, crimson and warm earth tones move across the land, while soft blue forms create a sense of water flowing through the valley. Rather than painting a particular view exactly, I allowed the landscape to develop intuitively. Small trees, distant hills and winding forms appear like fragments of a remembered journey. The painting celebrates those moments when the natural world feels wonderfully alive—bright, untamed and filled with possibility. This one-of-a-kind acrylic painting is perfect for collectors seeking contemporary Australian landscape art that brings warmth, colour and calm into their home. The River Knew the Way is an intuitive celebration of movement, colour and trusting the path ahead. A winding blue river travels through vivid pink fields, green hills and warm earthy forms, drawing the eye towards the distant mountains. Rather than depicting one particular place, the painting brings together fragments of landscape, memory and imagination. The river becomes a quiet symbol of hope—a reminder that even when the destination is unclear, life can continue carrying us towards something beautiful.
